description: Figure 6(a), titled "Self-reflection SFT data statistic," is a bar chart that displays the distribution of different reasoning types within the self-reflection SFT dataset. The horizontal axis lists five distinct reasoning categories: "Other Math," "Geometric Math," "Charts Diagrams," "Natural Science," and "General Reasoning." The vertical axis, labeled "Number of Samples," is scaled from 0 to 14,000 in increments of 2,000. The chart shows that the "Other Math" category has the highest number of samples, with a value of 14,333. The "Geometric Math" category follows with 10,227 samples. The "Charts Diagrams" category has 5,953 samples, "Natural Science" has 3,343, and "General Reasoning" has 3,534. The bars are arranged in descending order of sample count from left to right.
